'''Wyatt Styrene''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. He was a former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]].

==Biography==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Wyatt Styrene was the captain of the [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] prison barge after he abandoned his career as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. He was well versed in unexplored systems and enjoyed engaging in firefights. While en route to the Hive 7 space station, the ''Purge'' was attacked by [[Z-95 Headhunter]]s. Soon, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the Hutt's yacht, the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], was attached to the barge, and his servants captured the ''Purge'' in order to infiltrate the Hive-7 station, with the commandant of which Jabba had a conflict. Captain Styrene had his throat slit by Jabba's servants, leaving him strapped into a swivel chair in front of the bridge's command console.
